# rd_sideband_cards (issue 189): a fixture whose only drops are cards, then the
# counts a run of it shows (generated geometry: re-derived from a run of
# rd_replay_tool --region-stats; the rule from the code): ps2drops (every drop
# a card's under the PS2's rule), cameradrawn (the card facing the eye, drawn by
# the camera rule), camerakept (the card facing away, its drop kept)
fx-cards-189 ps2drops=580 cameradrawn=476 camerakept=104
